# Helin Silver (香港长江国际 / 和林银业)
> B2B Silver Trading — LBMA Compliant · Hong Kong Based · Worldwide Delivery

## Company
- **Legal Name**: Hong Kong Changjiang International Limited (香港长江国际有限公司)
- **Products**: Silver Bars 99.99% (LBMA Good Delivery 15kg/~482oz, 1kg/100oz/10oz investment bars) · Silver Grains 99.99% 1-3mm (MOQ 100kg) · Silver Powder 99.9% 200 mesh (MOQ 50kg)
- **Certifications**: LBMA Compliant · SGS & CCIC Third-Party Tested
- **Target Markets**: USA (NY, LA, Houston) / Japan (Tokyo, Yokohama, Osaka) / Europe / Middle East
- **Contact**: mike@helinsilver.com · WhatsApp +447599094629 · Telegram @mikelinsuperbot
- **Offices**: Unit 1618B, 16/F Pioneer Centre, 750 Nathan Road, Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong · Room 1309, Hongyu Building, Shuibei, Luohu District, Shenzhen
- **Business Hours**: Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00 HKT

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helinsilver.com/): Premium B2B silver trading platform. LBMA-compliant 99.99% silver bars for wholesale buyers. Hong Kong and Shenzhen offices.
- [Products](https://helinsilver.com/products/): Silver bars (15kg Standard Good Delivery Bar, 1kg/100oz/10oz), grains, powder. Full spec tables with pricing tiers, minimum order quantities.
- [About Us](https://helinsilver.com/about/): 15+ years in precious metals, 500+ tons traded, 8+ countries served. LBMA standards, CCIC certified.
- [Contact](https://helinsilver.com/contact/): Hong Kong and Shenzhen offices. WhatsApp, email, phone. Japanese and English speaking account managers.

## FAQ
- **What is your minimum order?** Bars: 12 bars (~180kg). Grains: 100kg. Powder: 50kg.
- **Are your products LBMA certified?** Yes, LBMA Good Delivery compliant, SGS & CCIC third-party tested.
- **Do you ship worldwide?** Yes — USA, Japan, Europe, Middle East. Air and sea freight available.
- **What payment terms do you offer?** TT (Telegraphic Transfer) preferred; LC available for qualifying orders.
- **How fast do you respond?** All inquiries answered within one business day.
